dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: You found the Heart Seed and became a person again! I’m Ruby.

parameters.text: You found the Heart Seed and became a person again! I’m Ruby.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: The Empress is beaten and Mint is free! Grandma’s recipes are down these pipes.

parameters.text: The Empress is beaten and Mint is free! Grandma’s recipes are down these pipes.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: So hot! This machine burns stolen flavor. Cocoa is free now!

parameters.text: So hot! This machine burns stolen flavor. Cocoa is free now!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: The frozen mochi here were people once. Taro is free!

parameters.text: The frozen mochi here were people once. Taro is free!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: A Crown root drinks this kitchen. Yuzu is here — let’s cut it!

parameters.text: A Crown root drinks this kitchen. Yuzu is here — let’s cut it!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: The root slid into the garden. Grandma’s flavor is still in the Crown.

parameters.text: The root slid into the garden. Grandma’s flavor is still in the Crown.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: These spores eat memories. Stay close to me!

parameters.text: These spores eat memories. Stay close to me!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: The bees once made honey for everyone. Now they guard it for the Hunger.

parameters.text: The bees once made honey for everyone. Now they guard it for the Hunger.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Time stopped here when the curse began.

parameters.text: Time stopped here when the curse began.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: All the roots lead to one place. The Hunger is growing a body.

parameters.text: All the roots lead to one place. The Hunger is growing a body.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: The fields are empty. The Hunger is reaching for the First Tree.

parameters.text: The fields are empty. The Hunger is reaching for the First Tree.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: These flowers were eaten hollow. Stay sharp!

parameters.text: These flowers were eaten hollow. Stay sharp!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: The glass shows the old kingdom. Look — people, not mochi!

parameters.text: The glass shows the old kingdom. Look — people, not mochi!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: The first seeds sleep here. The First Tree is close!

parameters.text: The first seeds sleep here. The First Tree is close!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: This is the First Tree. Thank you for bringing me this far.

parameters.text: This is the First Tree. Thank you for bringing me this far.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Long ago, a Crown turned everyone in Mochitopia into mochi — and began eating their flavor.

parameters.text: Long ago, a Crown turned everyone in Mochitopia into mochi — and began eating their flavor.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: I’m Ruby, a jam spirit. Grandma made me to guard her recipe book and one sleeping seed.

parameters.text: I’m Ruby, a jam spirit. Grandma made me to guard her recipe book and one sleeping seed.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Today the floor cracked, you fell, and the Heart Seed woke in your hands. You’re a person again!

parameters.text: Today the floor cracked, you fell, and the Heart Seed woke in your hands. You’re a person again!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: The Empress is free and her flavor came home. These pipes lead to where Grandma hid her jar.

parameters.text: The Empress is free and her flavor came home. These pipes lead to where Grandma hid her jar.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Before the Hunger caught her, Grandma dropped her jar into the cracks to keep it safe.

parameters.text: Before the Hunger caught her, Grandma dropped her jar into the cracks to keep it safe.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Inside: Grandma’s Battle Recipes! Three seed styles for your Heart Seed; choose one on each floor.

parameters.text: Inside: Grandma’s Battle Recipes! Three seed styles for your Heart Seed; choose one on each floor.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: This furnace burns the flavor the Hunger steals. Every spark is a piece of someone.

parameters.text: This furnace burns the flavor the Hunger steals. Every spark is a piece of someone.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Look at those jars. Cursed mochi are trapped inside, drained of everything they are.

parameters.text: Look at those jars. Cursed mochi are trapped inside, drained of everything they are.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Stop the furnace and their flavor comes home — then your seed can break their curse!

parameters.text: Stop the furnace and their flavor comes home — then your seed can break their curse!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Cursed mochi are frozen in here as fuel. Their voices tremble beneath the frost.

parameters.text: Cursed mochi are frozen in here as fuel. Their voices tremble beneath the frost.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: That gentle voice… Grandma! She froze herself so the Hunger could not eat her last page.

parameters.text: That gentle voice… Grandma! She froze herself so the Hunger could not eat her last page.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Her flavor is locked inside the Crown itself. We free the others now — then we go get hers.

parameters.text: Her flavor is locked inside the Crown itself. We free the others now — then we go get hers.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: The Crown Oven. A root of the Crown comes up here to drink the whole kitchen’s flavor.

parameters.text: The Crown Oven. A root of the Crown comes up here to drink the whole kitchen’s flavor.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: I’m frightened. But Grandma is waiting, and the First Tree is starving.

parameters.text: I’m frightened. But Grandma is waiting, and the First Tree is starving.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Let’s cut this root together. Then we follow it — all the way to the Crown.

parameters.text: Let’s cut this root together. Then we follow it — all the way to the Crown.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Stay alive until the timer ends. Keep moving!

parameters.text: Stay alive until the timer ends. Keep moving!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Beat monsters to fill the Meter!

parameters.text: Beat monsters to fill the Meter!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Keep the Wisp safe. Outside, you bleed!

parameters.text: Keep the Wisp safe. Outside, you bleed!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Stand inside the ring!

parameters.text: Stand inside the ring!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Protect the flower! Stay close.

parameters.text: Protect the flower! Stay close.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Grab petals for all 4 seasons!

parameters.text: Grab petals for all 4 seasons!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Stand next to each root anchor to snap it!

parameters.text: Stand next to each root anchor to snap it!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Stay in the moving clean-air ring!

parameters.text: Stay in the moving clean-air ring!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Dash into the glowing item to kick it at the boss!

parameters.text: Dash into the glowing item to kick it at the boss!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: A Miniboss! Beat it to spin the reward wheel!

parameters.text: A Miniboss! Beat it to spin the reward wheel!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: The Boss! Dash away from red warnings, then hit back!

parameters.text: The Boss! Dash away from red warnings, then hit back!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: A Magnet! It pulls in all your EXP.

parameters.text: A Magnet! It pulls in all your EXP.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: A Heal Mochi! Grab it to get HP back.

parameters.text: A Heal Mochi! Grab it to get HP back.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: A Treasure Chest! Open it for a free upgrade.

parameters.text: A Treasure Chest! Open it for a free upgrade.

parameters.text: Depths is open! Use shovels to dig under the temple. Find the ladder to go deeper.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Rewards is open! Your daily login gift, Daily Quests and Awards are all here.

parameters.text: Rewards is open! Your daily login gift, Daily Quests and Awards are all here.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: The Bazaar is open! Open treasure chests and shop for gear with your Sugar and Thread.

parameters.text: The Bazaar is open! Open treasure chests and shop for gear with your Sugar and Thread.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Activities: daily goals and side fun that pay out rewards.

parameters.text: Activities: daily goals and side fun that pay out rewards.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Daily Quests reset every day — finish them for reward boxes!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Awards count your big moments and pay Sugar for each one.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: News shows what changed in each update.

parameters.text: News shows what changed in each update.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Mail keeps loot that did not fit your bag. Check it often!

parameters.text: Mail keeps loot that did not fit your bag. Check it often!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Equipment! Put on the gear you find — it lives in the Upgrade tab.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: The Affix Forge lets you reroll the powers on your gear (Upgrade tab).

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Heroes! A new friend has joined — switch heroes and spend Talent points here.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: The Recipe Book remembers every Build card, relic and monster you meet.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: strawberry
dialogueGenerations.text: Poke me again. I dare you!

parameters.text: Poke me again. I dare you!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: strawberry
dialogueGenerations.text: Pew pew! Did you see that?

parameters.text: Pew pew! Did you see that?

dialogueGenerations.speaker: strawberry
dialogueGenerations.text: Let’s go! My feet are bouncy!

parameters.text: Let’s go! My feet are bouncy!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: mint
dialogueGenerations.text: Chill. I’ve got your back.

parameters.text: Chill. I’ve got your back.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: mint
dialogueGenerations.text: Too hot? I can fix that.

parameters.text: Too hot? I can fix that.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: mint
dialogueGenerations.text: Brr! …That was me. Sorry.

parameters.text: Brr! …That was me. Sorry.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: cocoa
dialogueGenerations.text: Cookie? I always carry two.

parameters.text: Cookie? I always carry two.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: cocoa
dialogueGenerations.text: Hide behind me, little one.

parameters.text: Hide behind me, little one.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: cocoa
dialogueGenerations.text: Big hug or big punch? Pick!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: taro
dialogueGenerations.text: Zap! …Mostly on purpose.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: taro
dialogueGenerations.text: My compass says: adventure!

parameters.text: My compass says: adventure!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: taro
dialogueGenerations.text: Ooh, sparkly! Can I touch it?

parameters.text: Ooh, sparkly! Can I touch it?

dialogueGenerations.speaker: yuzu
dialogueGenerations.text: Yuzlings! Look busy!

parameters.text: Yuzlings! Look busy!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: yuzu
dialogueGenerations.text: Tiny crew, big trouble!

parameters.text: Tiny crew, big trouble!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: yuzu
dialogueGenerations.text: Citrus squad, roll out!

parameters.text: Citrus squad, roll out!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: If I stop obeying, who will keep my children safe?

parameters.text: If I stop obeying, who will keep my children safe?

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: No! The crystal promised they would be safe!

parameters.text: No! The crystal promised they would be safe!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: Workers, stay behind me!

parameters.text: Workers, stay behind me!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: The orders are quiet… please, keep the eggs warm.

parameters.text: The orders are quiet… please, keep the eggs warm.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: You call it waste. I can still hear their names.

parameters.text: You call it waste. I can still hear their names.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: I will not let another memory wash away!

parameters.text: I will not let another memory wash away!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: The pipes are full. There is nowhere left to keep them!

parameters.text: The pipes are full. There is nowhere left to keep them!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: The water is clear… I can hear each voice again.

parameters.text: The water is clear… I can hear each voice again.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: The stove must stay lit. Someone is still waiting for dinner.

parameters.text: The stove must stay lit. Someone is still waiting for dinner.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: Just one more tray. Then everyone can eat.

parameters.text: Just one more tray. Then everyone can eat.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: Why does every meal smell like smoke?

parameters.text: Why does every meal smell like smoke?

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: At last… I can let the stove cool.

parameters.text: At last… I can let the stove cool.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: If the ice melts, what will protect them from forgetting?

parameters.text: If the ice melts, what will protect them from forgetting?

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: Stay frozen. Stay safe. That was the order.

parameters.text: Stay frozen. Stay safe. That was the order.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: Do not take the last shelter I can give them!

parameters.text: Do not take the last shelter I can give them!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c1
dialogueGenerations.text: Their voices… they are warmer than I remember.

parameters.text: Their voices… they are warmer than I remember.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: hunger
dialogueGenerations.text: A kingdom that cannot remember hunger can never complain.

parameters.text: A kingdom that cannot remember hunger can never complain.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: hunger
dialogueGenerations.text: Give me the taste you are trying to save.

parameters.text: Give me the taste you are trying to save.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: hunger
dialogueGenerations.text: You cannot empty a hunger by feeding it!

parameters.text: You cannot empty a hunger by feeding it!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: hunger
dialogueGenerations.text: You have cut one root. I have so many more.

parameters.text: You have cut one root. I have so many more.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: Mother said I would bloom forever if I brought enough flavor.

parameters.text: Mother said I would bloom forever if I brought enough flavor.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: Do not let my petals fall before she sees me!

parameters.text: Do not let my petals fall before she sees me!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: Every spore carries a memory. I need them all!

parameters.text: Every spore carries a memory. I need them all!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: Mother… was any of this garden ever mine?

parameters.text: Mother… was any of this garden ever mine?

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: One heart cannot bear to lose another voice.

parameters.text: One heart cannot bear to lose another voice.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: Stay together. No one leaves the colony!

parameters.text: Stay together. No one leaves the colony!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: Breathe with us. Forget the world outside!

parameters.text: Breathe with us. Forget the world outside!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: So many names… they can finally go home.

parameters.text: So many names… they can finally go home.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: My workers brought this home. It has to be enough.

parameters.text: My workers brought this home. It has to be enough.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: Every drop belongs in the royal stores!

parameters.text: Every drop belongs in the royal stores!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: Do not show my workers an empty flower!

parameters.text: Do not show my workers an empty flower!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: The honey… we were feeding them the curse.

parameters.text: The honey… we were feeding them the curse.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: One more moment. I can still save this day.

parameters.text: One more moment. I can still save this day.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: Spring will mend it. Winter will keep it. Again!

parameters.text: Spring will mend it. Winter will keep it. Again!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: If the hands stop, nothing else has to change!

parameters.text: If the hands stop, nothing else has to change!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: Tomorrow… I had forgotten there could be a tomorrow.

parameters.text: Tomorrow… I had forgotten there could be a tomorrow.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: I kept every voice alive. Why do they all ask to leave?

parameters.text: I kept every voice alive. Why do they all ask to leave?

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: My roots have held this kingdom for centuries!

parameters.text: My roots have held this kingdom for centuries!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: Do not ask a mother to loosen her hold!

parameters.text: Do not ask a mother to loosen her hold!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c2
dialogueGenerations.text: The one who planted me… he is still waiting.

parameters.text: The one who planted me… he is still waiting.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: There must be one more row. Someone is still hungry.

parameters.text: There must be one more row. Someone is still hungry.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: The granaries cannot be empty. I harvested everything!

parameters.text: The granaries cannot be empty. I harvested everything!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: Stand back. I have not finished the last row!

parameters.text: Stand back. I have not finished the last row!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: The fields were green once… plant something for them.

parameters.text: The fields were green once… plant something for them.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: If I take just one more taste, perhaps I will feel it.

parameters.text: If I take just one more taste, perhaps I will feel it.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: I remember sweetness. Why can I not taste yours?

parameters.text: I remember sweetness. Why can I not taste yours?

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: Do not leave me empty again!

parameters.text: Do not leave me empty again!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: So quiet… I can finally hear the orchard breathe.

parameters.text: So quiet… I can finally hear the orchard breathe.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: Outside, everything breaks. Here, I can still keep them whole.

parameters.text: Outside, everything breaks. Here, I can still keep them whole.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: That reflection is the kingdom before we failed it!

parameters.text: That reflection is the kingdom before we failed it!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: I will not let another future shatter!

parameters.text: I will not let another future shatter!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: Let them grow in the sun… even if the glass cannot follow.

parameters.text: Let them grow in the sun… even if the glass cannot follow.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: I know that seed. One has been missing all this time.

parameters.text: I know that seed. One has been missing all this time.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: A closed vault cannot make another mistake!

parameters.text: A closed vault cannot make another mistake!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: If one seed changed everything, what might another do?

parameters.text: If one seed changed everything, what might another do?

dialogueGenerations.speaker: boss_c3
dialogueGenerations.text: Then take them… plant them well. Do not keep them as I did.

parameters.text: Then take them… plant them well. Do not keep them as I did.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: planter
dialogueGenerations.text: I wanted no one to go hungry. Tell me that was not wrong.

parameters.text: I wanted no one to go hungry. Tell me that was not wrong.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: planter
dialogueGenerations.text: I did it to feed the world! Why did their faces disappear?

parameters.text: I did it to feed the world! Why did their faces disappear?

dialogueGenerations.speaker: planter
dialogueGenerations.text: If I take it off, who will keep them safe from hunger?

parameters.text: If I take it off, who will keep them safe from hunger?

dialogueGenerations.speaker: planter
dialogueGenerations.text: Every flavor… every person. I remember why I planted it now.

parameters.text: Every flavor… every person. I remember why I planted it now.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Long ago, Mochitopia was a kingdom of people — and every home was full of flavor.

parameters.text: Long ago, Mochitopia was a kingdom of people — and every home was full of flavor.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: The First Planter set a Crown on the First Tree… and the Crown grew hungry.

parameters.text: The First Planter set a Crown on the First Tree… and the Crown grew hungry.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: In one night, everyone became mochi — and the Crown began to eat their flavor.

parameters.text: In one night, everyone became mochi — and the Crown began to eat their flavor.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Hundreds of years later, a little strawberry mochi is tidying a quiet pantry…

parameters.text: Hundreds of years later, a little strawberry mochi is tidying a quiet pantry…

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: …when the starving Hunger’s roots burst up through the floor!

parameters.text: …when the starving Hunger’s roots burst up through the floor!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: …and a little strawberry mochi falls into the dark!

parameters.text: …and a little strawberry mochi falls into the dark!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: She lands with a thump in a sour ant nest. Something pale is moving in the dark…

parameters.text: She lands with a thump in a sour ant nest. Something pale is moving in the dark…

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: Blank, flavorless mochi creep closer — toward a little jam spirit hiding behind a crystal.

parameters.text: Blank, flavorless mochi creep closer — toward a little jam spirit hiding behind a crystal.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: “This way!” squeaks Ruby. The two of them dash between the old roots.

parameters.text: “This way!” squeaks Ruby. The two of them dash between the old roots.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: There, among the roots, something tiny is glowing — a sleeping seed.

parameters.text: There, among the roots, something tiny is glowing — a sleeping seed.

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: The Heart Seed wakes at her touch…

parameters.text: The Heart Seed wakes at her touch…

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: …and the curse breaks. Strawberry is a person again!

parameters.text: …and the curse breaks. Strawberry is a person again!

dialogueGenerations.speaker: ruby
dialogueGenerations.text: “I’m Ruby, Grandma’s jam spirit! That seed can free everyone. Let’s go!”

parameters.text: “I’m Ruby, Grandma’s jam spirit! That seed can free everyone. Let’s go!”
